WITH valid_exams AS (
  SELECT e.ID, e.`aCL IgM`, p.SEX
  FROM Examination e
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) as overall_mean
  FROM valid_exams
  WHERE `aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
),
with_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    ve.ID, 
    ve.`aCL IgM`, 
    ve.SEX,
    (ve.`aCL IgM` - os.overall_mean) as deviation
  FROM valid_exams ve
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE ve.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL AND ve.SEX IS NOT NULL
),
sex_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(deviation) as sex_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviations
  GROUP BY SEX
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    wd.ID,
    wd.SEX,
    wd.`aCL IgM`,
    wd.deviation,
    (wd.deviation - sad.sex_avg_deviation) as excess
  FROM with_deviations wd
  JOIN sex_avg_deviations sad ON wd.SEX = sad.SEX
  WHERE wd.deviation > sad.sex_avg_deviation
)
SELECT 
  ID,
  SEX,
  `aCL IgM`,
  deviation,
  excess
FROM filtered
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN excess IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
